source_name: RCS — Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (LBR public search)
license: Public register (free search + free document download; certified extracts paid; reuse terms unclear)
notes: Authoritative company register, run by LBR. FREE public search by name/RCS number/matricule; basic info (name, RCS number, legal form, registered address, status) free. Many filed DOCUMENTS - articles of association, board resolutions, and annual accounts (comptes annuels) - are downloadable FREE on the company's RCS page. Certified extracts/official copies are PAID. The search UI is captcha-gated (verified: page references captcha + login) and there is NO open bulk/API. Recommended for MANUAL lookups; automation blocked. Keyed on RCS number + matricule.

organization: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) / Centrale des bilans (STATEC/BCL)
license: Public (filed in the register; free to download per company)
fields_observed: profit and loss account (compte de profits et pertes)
notes: Companies file annual accounts (comptes annuels) to the RCS. They are PUBLIC and FREE to download on the company's RCS page, usually as PDF (and filed via the structured eCDF format). Small companies file abridged accounts. There is NO open bulk export of the figures; structured data (eCDF) is collected centrally (Centrale des bilans) but not published openly. Document-based; OCR/parse the PDFs or use a commercial provider for structured figures at scale. Join on RCS number. EUR.

source_name: RESA — Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations (legal gazette)
fields_observed: company publications (incorporation, amendments, accounts deposits, dissolutions)
notes: RESA replaced the Mémorial C; it is the electronic gazette of company/association legal publications (incorporations, statute amendments, accounts deposits, dissolutions). Verified reachable (HTTP 200). Free to consult; publications reference the RCS number. Useful for events/history; not a structured company master.

source_name: RBE — Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (beneficial owners)
fields_observed: beneficial owners (name, nationality, month/year of birth, nature/extent of control)
notes: Register of beneficial owners (4th/5th AMLD). General public access was withdrawn after the 2022 CJEU ruling; access for professionals / those with legitimate interest. Not open bulk. Join on RCS number. Noted for completeness.

organization: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AED) / European Commission
notes: Luxembourg VAT number (LU + 8 digits) is separate from the RCS number and matricule. Validate via VIES (or AED). Validation only; does not enumerate companies. The RCS number / matricule are the register keys; VAT must be sourced/validated separately.

National open-data portal (uData). Verified: search 'entreprises' returns 71 datasets, all STATEC AGGREGATE enterprise statistics (demography, structural business statistics, creations/cessations) - NOT a per-company register, and NO RCS/financials bulk (searches for RCS/registre commerce/LBR returned 0). Context/statistics only.

Vendors resell the RCS register + parsed annual accounts + officers/documents. The realistic path to STRUCTURED financials + bulk at scale (since the RCS has no open bulk/API and financials are PDF). Proprietary, paid, per contract.
